title: Garaža | Frontier Hackathon
summary: The Garaža Frontier Hackathon is a 40-hour regional hackathon held in Belgrade for young builders under 26. Teams work alongside mentors to develop startup ideas from scratch, focusing on frontier technology and proper market research. The event offers $10,000 in cash prizes and a fully-funded trip to San Francisco for the team with the strongest potential.
